vlae.teks: Water wat in een rigting trek en 'n mens kan saamvat, soos in 'n rivier of die see.
vlae.rede: The second half of the relative clause has no repeated 'wat', so a Grade 4 reader can briefly parse "'n mens kan saamvat" as a new main clause (one can take it along) instead of 'which can carry a person away'. Adding 'wat' does not remove the subject/object ambiguity, and this definition was just corrected after a fact check and may be shared, so it is flagged rather than changed; a writer could resolve it with the study text's clearer order (the current carries a person along).
